description: Code Engine secrets: generic key/value, registry pull credentials, TLS, SSH. Values are never returned. Identify a secret with project_id and secret_name. Use refresh_icr_pull when a deploy fails to pull its image. Call get_schema with name ce_secret for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List secrets (names and formats). | get: Get one secret: format and key names, not values. Needs secret_name. | create: Create a secret; format is generic, registry, ssh_auth, basic_auth, tls, or service_access. Needs secret_name, format, data. | update: Replace the data of a secret; keys not in data are removed. Needs secret_name, data. | create_tls: Create (mode=create) or renew (mode=renew) a TLS secret from PEM files on disk. Needs secret_name, cert_pem_path, key_pem_path. | refresh_icr_pull: Recreate the ICR pull secret with fresh credentials from the server key. | delete: Delete a secret. Needs secret_name.

cert_pem_path.description: Absolute path to the certificate PEM file (e.g. ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/fullchain.pem)

data.description: Key/value pairs (values must be base64 encoded for binary formats)

key_pem_path.description: Absolute path to the private key PEM file (e.g. ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/privkey.pem)

mode.description: create (default) or renew an existing secret

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

secret_name.description: Secret name, from ce_secret action list.

name: ce_secret
